plan: [This is a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding (bid = my value) is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected payoff regardless of others. With value $9, bidding higher risks winning at a price above my value; bidding lower only reduces my win probability without increasing profit when I win. No prior rounds to learn from, ties are random. Therefore I will bid my true value, $9. ]

[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction; bidding your true private value is a weakly dominant strategy and maximizes expected profit across independent rounds. No prior history to update beliefs. Ties are resolved randomly but rare in continuous bids; bidding exactly my value avoids overpaying while capturing all profitable wins.]

[This is a sealed-bid, second-price auction (third-party highest pays second-highest). In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid your true private value to maximize expected profit. Bidding my value ($34) ensures I win whenever the second-highest bid is below my value and I pay that second-highest bid, avoiding overpayment. Ties are random but bidding truthfully remains optimal. Therefore I will submit a bid equal to my private value, $34.]
